BiblicalUsage: Ije-abarim is a place on the journey, the ruins of Abarim in the wilderness. In Numbers 21:11 Israel pitches in Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising, and in Numbers 33:44 the same camp is listed in the stages of the journey from Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the place name is a marker on the road: Israel camped there on the way to the land, and the journey is remembered stage by stage.
